envelope.description: Stop reading ids from folder names in locate

body.title: Stop reading ids from folder names in locate
body.summary: Change locate/infer.ts refFromDocPath and infer-daemon.ts to map a docs path to its artifact through stored metadata instead of parsing the folder name; update locate-parent.ts and bugfix/tracker.ts for the new ResolvedRef outputs and convert stored parentRef.slug values. Test locating and linking a parent in a repository with several epics.
acceptanceChecks: no locate code parses a folder name into an id
a parent is located and linked correctly with multiple epics
a stored parentRef.slug is converted or reported, not guessed
the locate and bugfix tests pass

tests.name: src/workflow/locate/__tests__/locate-parent-ids.test.ts: a parent is located and linked correctly in a repository with several epics and no code parses a folder name into an id
